prompt.alinti: These seven GitHub repos will save you months of building AI agents, and almost nobody is talking about them yet. So first up is browser use, where your agent opens a real browser and runs the whole workflow the way a person would, clicking through pages and filling everything out on its own. Then agent memory gives your coding agent memory that sticks, so it learns across tasks instead of starting from zero every session. Third is scientific agent skills, which is 160 plus skills that basically turn a general agent into a research assistant. And fourth is diagram design, a clean set of diagrams built specifically for cloud code workflows. Fifth one is Anthropix cybersecurity skills built for modern coding agents. Sixth is awesome harness engineering for orchestration patterns. And the last one is open Viking for context.
